nodes.title_or_display: Mappings must establish a financial relationship

judgment.entry_belief: Source labels need explicit financial relationships before substitution or aggregation.
judgment.open_question: When can a mapping compose or an axis be summed without double counting?
judgment.parent_contribution: Defines contextual mapping relationships and partition evidence with valid/invalid examples.
judgment.belief_update: Component then equivalence remains component; transforms need compatible intermediate bases. Product-region and channel classifications cannot be pooled, and an unallocated residual is not zero.
judgment.exit_question: Which eligible assertion version does a query actually select?
judgment.removal_verdict: The shared260 revenue classified on two axes is the concrete double-counting failure case.

judgment.entry_verdict: Mapping source, target, relationship, context and transformation are stated before the composition rules.
judgment.exit_verdict: Vendor non-trade receivables and gross derivatives anchor the prohibition on silent relabeling/netting.
judgment.promise_verdict: Company extensions preserve distinctions but cannot override mandatory recognition rules.
judgment.distinct_contribution_verdict: A financial relationship, rather than similar naming, licenses every allowed composition or sum.

judgment.entry_belief: Retained assertions have compatible contexts and separate clocks, but several revisions can survive.
judgment.open_question: Which assertion does an original, latest or harmonised query return?
judgment.parent_contribution: Makes time eligibility and explicit supersession govern selection rather than file order.
judgment.belief_update: Acyclic contextual lineage selects roots or eligible live leaves. Revenue revisions do not revise every note; prospective estimates and retrospective corrections produce different dated consequences.
judgment.exit_question: What authority does acceptance of the selected reading actually confer?

judgment.promise_verdict: Conflicts and incomplete transformations remain visible rather than being resolved by newest storage time.

judgment.entry_belief: The representation can retain and select a policy sentence.

judgment.parent_contribution: Separates literal accuracy, meaning, purpose-specific admission and accounting applicability.
judgment.belief_update: FIFO and straight-line wording constrain a proposed reading while leaving quantities, useful lives and event facts missing. ASBE's substitution-right presumption has stated conditions rather than arbitrary probability thresholds.
judgment.exit_question: How should a faithful reading be treated when its own reference is wrong?

nodes.title_or_display: When a faithful reading preserves a wrong reference

judgment.entry_belief: Transcription and accounting eligibility are separate decisions.
judgment.open_question: Can Item15's156 direction be retained while the supported auditor-report location is163?
judgment.parent_contribution: Uses an actual source disagreement to specify review, repair and dependency consequences.

judgment.entry_belief: A located note or repaired reference does not finish company interpretation.

judgment.parent_contribution: Defines retained-unit, assertion-review and query-exposure populations with separate obligations.

judgment.promise_verdict: Neither all acquired pages nor a reviewed debt total closes missing incorporated contracts.

nodes.title_or_display: Displayed precision does not determine a rounding rule

judgment.entry_belief: A numeric assertion preserves scale and precision metadata.

judgment.parent_contribution: Separates display scale from an admitted issuer-rounding model.

judgment.entry_belief: Each inspected tradition supplies a bounded contribution.

judgment.parent_contribution: Identifies the integration from disclosures to conditional statements as the remaining design problem.

judgment.exit_question: Which architecture can join them while keeping the alternatives credible?

judgment.entry_belief: Literature leaves a concrete integration problem.

judgment.parent_contribution: Defines shared representation, comparator, component reuse and semantic ownership.
